meta_title: Evergreen Complete Garden Services | Gardener Leicester
meta_description: Evergreen Complete Garden Services in Leicester offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Local, reliable gardeners serving Leicestershire.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to finished landscaping, we transform outdoor spaces across Leicester and transform them into places you'll actually use.
services_subhead: Whether it's a spring tidy or a full garden redesign, we handle landscaping, maintenance, tree work, and seasonal care year-round.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cuts, edging, scarifying, and feeding to keep your garden looking sharp all season. We work around your schedule and adjust care as the year changes.

services.title: Borders, Beds & Planting Design
services.desc: Transform tired borders with new planting schemes tailored to your soil and light. We source quality plants and handle all preparation and aftercare.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping Installation
services.desc: Natural stone, porcelain, or block paving laid to professional standard. We'll design a space that drains properly, looks level, and lasts years.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Cutting
services.desc: Skilled pruning, shaping, and felling with waste removal. We work safely and keep trees healthy whilst respecting your garden's character.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Overhaul
services.desc: Tackling overgrown gardens and removing debris, dead wood, and rubbish. We leave you with a clean slate and clear plan for what comes next.

services.title: Fencing & Garden Structures
services.desc: Installation and repair of fencing, gates, pergolas, and raised beds. Built to last with quality materials and proper fixings.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I love seeing people enjoy their gardens again.
about_para_1: Evergreen Complete Garden Services has been trading across Leicester and the surrounding areas for over 12 years. We started as a one-man operation and have grown to a small, trusted team because we listen to what customers want and deliver it properly. Every job, whether a weekly cut or a full landscaping project, gets the same attention to detail and care.
about_para_2: Our customers come back year after year because we're reliable, honest about costs, and we actually turn up when we say we will. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair value—and we stand behind every job we do. Many of our clients have been with us for five, eight, even ten years, which tells us everything about how we work.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Fantastic job on our back garden. We'd let it get a bit wild and thought about getting someone else in, but Evergreen made the whole thing manageable. They cleared everything, laid new patio, and replanted the borders. Came in on budget and on time. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using them for lawn maintenance for three years now. Always professional, never let us down, and the garden looks brilliant. They listen to what you want rather than just doing what they fancy. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah J.

reviews.text: Called them to deal with an overgrown hedge blocking our light. Within two days they'd quoted, and a week later it was all done—trimmed back, chipped, and neat. Fair price and friendly crew. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David P.
